summary: A Russell County lookout site near Sewellton, given to the Division of Forestry in 1960 with a tower planned; the regional site lists it as removed.

facts.status_note: Listed as removed; no removal date or reason is given.

events.note: Homer and Rita Kinnett gave a lookout tower site near Sewellton to the Division of Forestry; the item describes planned foundations that autumn and erection the next spring.

evidence.supports: item dated August 4, 1960, quoting the Clinton County News
Kinnett gift of a site to the Division of Forestry
evidence.quote: Homer and Rita Kinnett have given a lookout tower site to the Division of Forestry.

evidence.supports: site near Sewellton at the junction of US 127 and KY 55
evidence.quote: This is near Sewellton and the Junction of US 127 and Ky. Route 55.
The ground elevation is over 1100 feet.

evidence.supports: foundations planned for the autumn, tower the next spring
evidence.quote: The foundations will be put in this fall--and the tower--erected next spring.

evidence.supports: planned tower to work with Crocus and a Green River Knob tower for Russell County coverage
evidence.quote: This tower along with Crocus and another tower to be built on the Green River Knob should give Russell County good lookout coverage.

evidence.supports: site listed as removed, no date or reason

notes_for_editor: Single source: a regional site quoting a 1960 Clinton County News item, with the status word Removed and no date. The article describes a plan; nothing in the cache confirms a tower was erected. The record's point (36.9253, -85.1148) is roughly 1.5 km from the USGS GNIS populated-place point for Sewellton (36.936, -85.105); the cached page gives no coordinates, so the record's point is unverified. The firetower.org Kentucky list in the cache shows 8 registered former sites but its names did not render, so Sewellton's absence from it is not confirmed. The record's access and visit fields are left unknown; no source describes the site today.
